description: npm/pnpm updates only. Dependabot keeps GitHub Actions and Docker; it cannot update npm here because it does not support the pinned Node 26.

packageRules.description: Grouped like the former Dependabot npm entry: every non-major update in one PR per dependency type.
Node types follow the pinned runtime major (.node-version, devEngines); that moves by hand.
Node and pnpm in devEngines/packageManager are pinned together and move by hand.
